events.description:

Enter Gate 4 (main front gate) or Gate 6 (parking lot), and you'll find us on the blacktop lunch tables. Food trucks will be on site! 🚚
Volunteers needed here: https://www.signupgenius.com/go/805054DADAC29A6FF2-64518460-bingo#/
